title_zh: 寻找战争历史展厅的地图资料

scenario.goal_zh: 向博物馆工作人员询问地方历史展览与资料。

context_zh: 游客在虚构地方博物馆询问展览位置，希望了解地图上的边界变化。
author: author-phase05-a

sentences.speaker: Harriet
sentences.text: Where can I find the exhibition about the war?

sentences.speaker: Museum guide
sentences.text: Upstairs, in the town history room. The map at the entrance is a useful place to start.

sentences.speaker: Harriet
sentences.text: Does it show the border before the fighting began?

sentences.speaker: Museum guide
sentences.text: Yes. There is a second map beside it showing the border afterward.

sentences.speaker: Harriet
sentences.text: And where is the display about the battle near the river?

sentences.speaker: Museum guide
sentences.text: At the back of that room, beside the display of a bomb that was made safe for the museum.

sentences.speaker: Harriet
sentences.text: Can I take a leaflet? I would like to compare the two maps properly.

sentences.speaker: Museum guide
sentences.text: Of course. Here is the exhibition guide, with both maps on page six.

sentences.speaker: Harriet
sentences.text: Thank you. I will start upstairs with the maps.
